goal: Fourth write-back batch: fold the 27 unit candidates recalled in three source documents (doc_count = 3) across the 9 institution / procedure / event entity groups into 9 canonical knowledge units, and record how every duplicate candidate was resolved.

inputs.source_scope: six books only (Books 1-6); Books 7+ out of scope by user instruction

scope.group_rule: unit candidates recalled in three source documents (doc_count = 3), restricted in this batch to the institution, procedure and event entity groups; term / person / place / publication / work groups of the same layer are left to later batches
scope.slug_discrepancy_note: Two groups propose divergent slugs for one entity and were judged the same entity: xdup-0064 (xingwenshu / xingwen-shu) and xdup-0070 (bintieju / bintie-ju); xdup-0065 mixes pinyin slugs (yu-qi-chang, yuqichang) with an English one (imperial-porcelain-factory), xdup-0067 mixes fujian-chuanzhengju / fu-jian-chuan-zheng-ju / fujian-navy-yard, xdup-0097 mixes sectional-casting / fenzhu-fa / separate-casting. Each was written as one unit.
scope.type_coverage_note: opium-war.md is the first event-type knowledge unit in the repository; type coverage moves from 7/8 to 8/8.

method.semantic_step: Per-group re-read of the three recalling Markdown sources plus targeted line verification at the cited line numbers; every source disagreement (dates, institutional parentage, functional scope, term ordering) was kept as an explicit variance note instead of being resolved by preference.
method.canonical_rule: One canonical candidate per group is promoted to a knowledge unit; the remaining two same-name candidates transition to rejected with a reason naming the canonical target.
method.state_chain: needs_evidence -> ready_for_review -> approved -> applied for canonical; needs_evidence -> rejected for duplicates.
method.ledger: Append-only candidate-decision-ledger.jsonl with 45 rows over 27 unique candidate ids; historical R1 candidate ledgers untouched.
method.write_back: Typed exact change-set: 9 create actions, no update or delete.
method.payload_defect_note: The canonical candidate for xdup-0063 (2009-zhaonong-zhongguo-yishu-shejishi:cand-12-121) carries a payload that dates the war to 1842, while the same book elsewhere writes 道光20年（1840年）. The unit was written from the source text; the 1842 reading is recorded in the unit as an internal variance, not adopted.

source_variance_notes: 鸦片战争: 赵农同册并存「道光20年（1840年）……发动了鸦片战争」与「1842 年，英国发动鸦片战争」; 高丰作「1856年至1860年的第二次鸦片战争」为洋务运动契机; 「最早的民族近代工业」是否系于缫丝业仅夏燕靖两版作此判断, 且两版措辞不同; 郑观应《盛世危言》引文作者名「郑观应」(李立新) 与「郑观庆」(高丰)、用字「业冶/业治」「投闲/偷闲」并存; 赵农「英国生铁产量达到 139 吨」与「龙门火炮」两处原文异常.
兴文署: 《元史·百官志》「属集贤院」与《元秘书监志》「属秘书监」在同一段内互相冲突; 赵农另点《通志》与「官方审查制度严格」, 为夏燕靖两版所无; 两版同作「文艺监」.
御器厂: 高丰与田自秉同作「洪武三十五年」设置 (按明代纪年洪武止于三十一年, 原文照录); 地点「珠山」与钦限/部限分工仅田自秉一家; 夏燕靖两版与田自秉另一处的「御器厂或官窑的前身」系对唐越窑的追述, 不构成对明代御器厂的独立证据.
江宁织造局: 曹氏任职年数在夏燕靖 2016 同段内并存「58年」与「前后60余年」; 「曹颙、曹頡」与「孙颙、頫」为同段两处异写; 职能表述「特织御用云锦」(夏燕靖两版) 与「管理织锦的生产」(田自秉) 侧重不同; 田自秉所引「173张/800张、667人/2330人」系于苏州织造而非江宁.
福建船政局: 夏燕靖两版同册并存「1872年……奏报创办福建船政局意图」与「1866年5月，上奏清廷创办福建船政局」; 「沈葆祯」用字; 「用35年的时间，造船舰40艘」未给起讫年, 无法与李立新「1869年6月建造了中国第一艘近代蒸汽船」直接核对.
织染署: 田自秉给出隋代司染署与司织署合并为织染署的沿革, 其余四册只记唐制; 职掌「负责织造」(高丰) 与「掌供冠冕、组绶及织纴、色染」(赵农引《新唐书·百官志》) 宽窄不同; 用字「织纴」(赵农) 与「织衽」(田自秉) 并存; 赵农「25个作」与田自秉所引四类分项 10+5+4+6=25 相合, 构成来源内互证.
锦署: 田自秉所记「织锦署」在后赵邺城, 与东晋「锦署」同名异实 (时代、地点、名称均不同), 仅作对照, 不计入本实体证据; 夏燕靖两版把设置系于刘裕灭后秦迁关中工匠, 李立新只作「晋室南渡后，成立锦署」; 设置地点四册均未明写.
镔铁局: 夏燕靖两版作「专门冶炼铁铜等金属产品」(冶铸), 赵农作「管理镔铁镂刻、镶嵌金银的制作」(装饰加工), 两说属不同工序环节; 「工部总管府」原文如此, 与同段「集宁路总管府」含义不同.
分铸法: 田自秉作「浑铸→分铸→焊接」三段递进, 李立新作「分铸法最初是浑铸……后改为焊接」, 对同一组三个术语给出相反排列; 同一件司母戊鼎在四册中分别被定性为分铸法 (田自秉)、一次性整体铸造 (赵农)、接铸 (夏燕靖两版); 李立新「分铸法是工匠在长期技术经验中产生的一个技术设计」为六册中唯一的技术设计定性.

semantic_change.confidence_posture: All nine units are confidence=medium, consensus=tentative, evidence_status=source_backed. No unit is marked confirmed, externally verified, or L1-L7 verified. fenzhu-fa.md records an irreconcilable ordering dispute between sources but keeps consensus=tentative because the contract requires verification_level whenever consensus is not tentative, and no external verification was performed.

validation.type_coverage: 8/8 (event type unit added by this batch)
validation.sync_closure: run_sync_closure.py --refresh-generated --full --check-generated: sync closure passed (250 tests, 16 subtests)
validation.apply_plan_hash_check: all 9 rows verified against disk (sha256, bytes, lines; CRLF normalized to LF)
